source_binding: The implementation and tests were committed before the final builds and regressions. Documentation and this evidence are a separate follow-up.
scope: Exact source and scalar preservation, native console evidence, and grid-fitting DWrite text layouts with actual glyph-run evidence for four fixed samples. Whole-cluster shaping and width policy are explicitly excluded.

environment.harness: Owned non-input desktop and Job; no screenshots, foreground input or display-setting changes

renderer.initial_failure: gdi dpi=96 zoom=50: glyph layout exceeds the physical grid width
renderer.policy: Only over-wide DWrite layouts reduce font size to fit the existing one/two-cell physical grid; cell dimensions are not expanded.
renderer.cache_key: text, bold and actual cell width

native_console.non_bmp_cell_representation: Each supplementary scalar becomes a leading/trailing pair of U+FFFD cells; text projection exposes one replacement character per scalar.

observations: 0x1405fab20 uses whole-QString advance for Mark/skin-tone paths and per-scalar measurement otherwise.
0x1405faef0 provides another whole-string measurement path; the existing exports do not establish which caller or cluster representation is used.
The reviewed exports do not establish actual ZWJ/keycap cell width, cursor advancement or runtime WindTerm behavior.

open_follow_up.relationship: Native child and blocked-by dependency of #30; both remain open
open_follow_up.reason: Streaming grapheme segmentation and width/cursor contracts are unresolved. Current unicode-width 0.2.2 and zero-width append behavior do not establish a complete grapheme implementation; no new dependency was silently added.

candidate.failure_stage: Early text/input and close scenarios; a different or close-worker root cause is not established

candidate_workflow.scope: External core candidate workflow; it is not a substitute for the complete local candidate regression

default_workflow.normal_and_resize_interrupt_scenarios: Passed in this hosted run; this does not resolve the distinct local #36 failures
default_workflow.root_cause: Unresolved and tracked by #38; not attributed to the renderer fix, environment or #36 without evidence

limitations: This slice verifies exact source/scalar preservation and actual glyph layout only. It does not accept a complete ZWJ/keycap clustering, width, cursor or selection contract; #39 remains open.
Glyph-run identities and layout-width bounds do not prove per-pixel overhang or presented-frame correctness; no such visual claim is made.
The observed native replacement projection is not treated as original text, a WindTerm result, or proof of cross-platform behavior.
The full #30 Unicode/IME contract, application keyboard modes, selection of the added samples, real distinct-DPI transitions and presented frames remain unverified.
Only the explicit candidate build runs the new end-to-end scenario; the default self-developed core was not expanded to claim complex grapheme support.
Known #36/#38 failures and the full default/candidate regression results must remain visible; no complete-suite or R2 completion claim is made.
Raw private artifacts, third-party decompilation and the local native-only probe are not published. Public fixed scenarios and hashes support the documented limited reproduction.
